title: 🧪 [Testing Improvement] Verify prisma client test coverage
body:
## 🧪 Testing Improvement Task

### 🎯 What
Verified that `lib/prisma.ts` already has full test coverage. No code changes were necessary.

### 📊 Coverage
The existing test suite in `tests/prisma.test.ts` thoroughly tests the `prisma` client instantiation logic, correctly mocking the environment and ensuring coverage across `development` and `production` logic.

### ✨ Result
Confirmed 100% test coverage for `lib/prisma.ts` without needing any extra implementation.
